scope: All 14 actual original whole images individually viewed and forwarded to vision. No crop, pixel measurement, device/process/AX query, runtime execution, source edits, stage, or commit. No hardware or exact frame-presentation claim.
routineAndSourceTaskAdaptation: Unchanged current research.max-hangs prescribes both-hands edge tasks, half crimp, natural 10s Hang/180s Rest. Normal Mini UI explicitly says Use two boards, one hand on each; actual screenshots show two hands with one displayed board and its lower edge highlighted. This is not a manual Left-hand exercise, and the screenshots do not demonstrate two distinct rendered boards. No training content or duration was altered.
phaseSummary: Get Ready 3; first Hang 8 and 3; first Rest 2:58,2:53,1:44,0:04; second Hang 9 and 4; second Rest 2:59,2:54,2:49,2:44,2:38. All values transcribed from images, never derived from filename offsets.
limitations: Board is very small relative to hands and available space; fine geometry inspection limited.
An unidentified black left-edge pill is present at 190; no clean-screen blanket pass.
Five-second transition sampling does not establish continuous visibility or precise phase onset.
No CPU/app-phase or GPU completion brackets; no hardware validation.
Only one board is drawn despite the explicit instruction to use two physical boards.

reopenedOriginals.purpose: Confirm actual unidentified left-edge black pill before reporting.
